Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1042
Claimant:
James Hogan
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
5-8-24
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection, with the claimant reporting a neck strain and retaining cuonsel
before any statement was taken.
5-26-24
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant's vehicle in the intersection at the time of impact and confirms
the claimant was a passenger in that vehicle.
5-29-24
Driver is named on the policy and the policy was in force on the date of loss; nothing in the file suggests the damage
predates coverage.
6-12-24
Obtained photos from the scene and statements from two independent witnesses, all of which confirm the collision
happened as the claimant and the other driver described.
6-18-24
Inspected the claimant's vehicle. The driver-side door and quarter panel show clear impact damage consistent with a
side impact, though a few older scratches elsewhere on the body may predate this loss.
7-3-24
Medical records received show a neck strain diagnosis, and the mechanism and force of the collision appear
consistent with that type of injury.
8-29-24
No prior injury to the neck or upper back appears in the records we obtained, and the claimant denies any earlier
complaints to that area.
9-9-24
Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and medication, with visit frequency tapering as the claimant
reported steady improvement.
9-27-24
Counsel forwarded a demand package. Reviewing whether all of the claimed vehicle damage and treatment can be
attributed to this impact, as the scope of some repairs is not yet clear.
11-2-24
Claimant provided a follow-up recorded statement adding a few small details about the moments before and after
impact; the core account remains the same as the initial report.
11-17-24
Compared the updated statement against the police report, witness accounts and photos, and found the sequence of
events consistent across all sources.
11-24-24
Reserve reviewed and file referred for final evaluation of the injury and property components, with the open question
on damage scope noted for the handling adjuster.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
